venue.name: Art Gallery of Greater Victoria
venue.description: The Art Gallery of Greater Victoria is a public art gallery at 1040 Moss Street in Victoria that presents changing exhibitions developed with artists, art historians and community organizations. It offers School Programs of exhibition tours and workshops for Grades 2-12 led by the Gallery's education staff, plus self-guided school tours and bookable group tours.
venue.hours_notes: Monday: Closed. Tuesday 10AM-5PM, Wednesday 10AM-5PM, Thursday 10AM-9PM, Friday 10AM-5PM, Saturday 10AM-5PM, Sunday 12PM-5PM.
venue.seasonal_notes: Admission is free on the first Saturday of the month from 10 am - 5 pm and every Thursday evening from 5 pm - 9 pm (Feel Free days supported by TD Bank Group).

programs.name: School Tour + Workshop
programs.description: Education-staff-led, inquiry-based exploration of a current exhibition followed by a studio workshop. Price is $150 for the group. Includes a Teacher Study Guide with pre- and post-tour activities. Requires two weeks' notice and advance payment; the booking fee is non-refundable if cancelled within 14 days.
programs.evidence: Tour + Workshop Grades: 2-12 Price: $150 Time: Offered Tuesdays and Thursdays at 9:30am and 12:15pm Length: 2 hrs

programs.name: School Tour Only
programs.description: One-hour guided exhibition tour for school groups led by Gallery education staff, without the studio workshop. Price is $150 less, at $100 for the group. Includes a Teacher Study Guide. Requires two weeks' notice and advance payment.
programs.evidence: Tour Only Grades: 2-12 Price: $100 Time: Offered Tuesdays and Thursdays at 10:45am and 1:30pm Length: 1 hr

programs.name: Self-Guided School Tour
programs.description: School groups explore the exhibitions on their own to meet their own classroom objectives. Admission is free for youth 25 and under; each accompanying adult 25+ pays $15 (free for AGGV Members, See Art Pass holders, Indigenous peoples and support workers). One adult chaperone is required for every six elementary students and one for every ten secondary students. Must be booked in advance by emailing jengen@aggv.ca. Free lockable bins are provided for backpacks; food, drinks and backpacks are not allowed in the exhibitions.

programs.name: Exhibition Group Tour (Private Engagement Tour)
programs.description: One-hour tour of the current exhibitions led by a trained AGGV art educator, available in English, French and Japanese, described as suitable for classes, independent living and community groups. Price is $85 plus GST plus group admission, for up to 20 guests. Booked by email; the Visit page states requests must be made a minimum of 2 weeks in advance.
programs.evidence: The price is $85 + GST + Group Admission for up to 20 guests.

gaps: Youngest age welcomed is not stated. School Programs are advertised for Grades 2-12 only, and nothing on the site says whether preschool or kindergarten groups can be accommodated.

Conflict between pages on chaperones: the School Programs page (modified 2026-03-05) says 'maximum capacity of 30 students with at least 3 adult chaperones', while the School Program Guidelines page (modified 2025-07-17) says 'maximum capacity of 30 students with up to 6 adult chaperones'. Both agree on 1 adult per 6 elementary students. The maximum of 30 students is consistent on both pages.
It is not stated whether adult chaperones on a paid School Tour or Tour + Workshop are admitted free or must pay the $15 adult admission, so free_adults_per_children is null.
No lunch space or picnic area is mentioned. The site only says food, drinks and backpacks are not allowed in the exhibitions, so has_lunch_space is left null.
Bus or coach parking is not mentioned. The Accessibility page describes only one free accessible parking space and a loading zone with a curb cut-out in front of the main entrance.

Stroller access is not stated. The Accessibility page confirms ramps and wheelchair-accessible washrooms and entrance, but does not mention strollers, and notes the outdoor courtyard is not wheelchair accessible.
The self-guided school tour has no stated minimum lead time beyond 'must be booked in advance'; the two-week notice rule is stated only for the paid School Programs.
No price year or school year is attached to the $150 / $100 / $85 / $15 figures.
The $85 Exhibition Group Tour price is stated as '$85 + GST + Group Admission' but the group admission rate itself is not published anywhere on the site.

Images: no hero image could be captured. None of the pages opened that describe the venue itself (School Programs, Visit, Accessibility, School Program Guidelines) declares an Open Graph image, and no content photographs rendered in the fetched HTML for those pages - only the theme logo, the search and close icons and the social media buttons, all of which are excluded. The only usable photograph found on the pages opened was the Open Graph image on the Private Engagement Tours page, recorded as the program image for the Exhibition Group Tour. The AGGV site appears to load its page banners and gallery photos via JavaScript, so a hero photo would have to be picked up from a rendered browser view rather than fetched HTML.

Images: no photo credit, copyright line specific to an image, or image terms of use statement appears on the pages opened. The site has an 'Image Licensing' page linked in the Collection menu, but it was not among the pages opened for this extraction, so rights_note records only the site-wide footer copyright line.
